scenarios.title: Owner search
scenarios.assertion: A seeded owner is found by the specified name.

scenarios.title: Required fields
scenarios.assertion: The selected invalid owner form is rejected.

scenarios.title: Pet creation
scenarios.assertion: The new pet is associated with the selected owner.

scenarios.title: Visit
scenarios.assertion: The saved visit belongs to the intended pet.

scenarios.title: Migration parity
scenarios.assertion: Equivalent owner/pet/visit outcomes hold in both configured PetClinic variants.
